sections.Profile:
The "Smoke Signal" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company on May 25, 1955, is a single-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1955
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Western, Wood Rail, Original Theme
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Harry Williams
- Art: George Molentin
